chunks: Yet they make some of His creatures His offspring! Man is surely most ungrateful.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about humans attributing offspring to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the pre-Islamic Arabs' attribution of daughters to Allah, highlighting the logical inconsistency of creating partners from among one's own servants. It underscores the human tendency toward 'clear ingratitude' (kufur mubin) by failing to recognize the Creator's absolute transcendence and unity (Tawhid). This serves as a foundational argument against anthropomorphic conceptions of the divine in Islamic theology.
